chunks: And with the same chain of narration, from Abu al-Qasim Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Hanafiyya, may Allah have mercy on him, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
He who does not have mercy on our young ones, and shows no reverence to our elders, and does not recognize our rights, is not from us.

key_terms.حق: Right -- the divinely established rights of the Ahlul Bayt to respect, obedience, and recognition
key_terms.رحمة: Mercy, compassion -- gentle treatment and care toward those younger or weaker

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about showing mercy to the young and respecting the elders of Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyya (son of Imam Ali), the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) defines the minimum standards of belonging to the Prophet's community: showing mercy to the young members of the Ahlul Bayt, respecting the elders, and recognizing the rights of the Prophet's household. This hadith establishes that love of Ahlul Bayt involves concrete actions, not just verbal affirmation.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
